## Type of change

- [ ] Content update (`src/content/**`)
- [ ] Feature / UI change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Release-readiness / repository hygiene

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run validate:content`
- [ ] `npm run validate:links`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run check:release` (recommended before merging to `main`)
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` (if the change touches routes, navigation, or forms)

## Manual checks (if applicable)

- [ ] Verified in light mode and dark mode
- [ ] Verified at mobile width (no horizontal overflow)
- [ ] No placeholder/fake content introduced
- [ ] No secrets committed (`.env`, API keys, etc.)
